name: Ghorepani Poon Hill Trek
sub_region: Myagdi and Kaski Districts, Gandaki Province (Annapurna Conservation Area)

difficulty.notes: Short teahouse loop; hardest section is ~3,000+ stone steps between Tikhedhunga and Ulleri. Max altitude 3,210 m. Some operators grade it easy-moderate. [s4][s5][s6]

duration_days.notes: 5-day loop is standard; 4-day version skips the Tikhedhunga night; 3-day version drives high toward Ulleri/Ghorepani; 6-7 day versions add Landruk or Panchase. Add 2-3 days for Kathmandu arrival/transfer. [s5][s6]

itinerary.route: Pre-dawn hike to Poon Hill (3,210 m) - Ghorepani - Deurali - Tadapani
itinerary.notes: 45-60 min climb to the viewpoint for sunrise over Dhaulagiri and Annapurna. Tadapani listed 2,590-2,630 m. [s4][s6]

best_seasons.notes: Rhododendron forest blooms red and pink in March-April. [s6] Shorter winter daylight makes the 4-day combined day harder. [s5]

permits.name: Annapurna Conservation Area Permit (ACAP)
permits.fee: NPR 3,000 per foreign national (SAARC NPR 1,000), tax included

guide_requirements: NTB lists 'Poon Hill-ABC Trek' among Annapurna routes requiring a licensed guide arranged by a registered agency since 31 March 2023. [s3] Operators state a guide is mandatory since April 2023. [s5]

drives: Optional jeep from Pokhara to Hile/Tikhedhunga or toward Ulleri to shorten day 1 [s6]

highlights: Sunrise from Poon Hill (3,210 m) over Dhaulagiri (8,167 m), Annapurna South and Machhapuchhre [s4]
Rhododendron and oak forest between Ghorepani and Tadapani [s4][s6]
Gurung village of Ghandruk and its cultural museum [s5]
Magar village of Ghorepani on its ridge [s6]
risks: Steep stone steps (Ulleri ascent, Tadapani-Ghandruk descent) hard on knees, slippery when wet [s5]
Crowding at Poon Hill and Ghorepani lodges in peak season

acclimatization.notes: Not needed at these altitudes for most trekkers.

unverified: TIMS requirement in practice for Poon Hill in 2026 (NTB lists it; operators report it is not checked in Annapurna).
Crowding at Poon Hill in peak season (general observation, not sourced).
Grade: sources vary between easy and easy-moderate.
